title: Adopt Clean Light Porcelain Aesthetic with Gel Personas
context: Dark gloomy cockpit with technical engine jargon alienated users. The product needs an approachable, delightful agency feeling.
decision: Transition to crisp #F8FAFC porcelain background, pure white cards, soft ambient drop shadows, and 5 animated translucent Gel Assistants.
consequences: Dramatically improved user engagement and visual appeal; all heavy rendering engines operate cleanly in the background.

title: Migrate Riverpod 3.x State Management to NotifierProvider
context: StateProvider is unavailable in Riverpod 3.x configurations.
decision: All state notifiers must extend Notifier<T> or AsyncNotifier<T> with explicit semantic mutators.
consequences: Compile-time safety, predictable mutations, and cleaner test mocking.

title: Local First Knowledge Base Ingestion for ButaAI Engine
context: User identified mock responses as a critical failure. ButaAI must be taught with real database and engineering rules.
decision: Ingest Antigravity knowledge base (Riverpod, SwiftUI, Double-Bezel design, 18s launch video) into Modelfile system prompt and runtime JSON database.
consequences: ButaAI provides authentic, intelligent, database-grounded advice with zero external cloud dependencies.
